Matrix.mul_assoc.{v, u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {l : Type u_1} {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} {o : Type u_4} {α : Type v}
  [NonUnitalSemiring α] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (L : Matrix l m α) (M : Matrix m n α) (N : Matrix n o α) :
  L * M * N = L * (M * N)
Matrix.det_vandermonde.{u_1} {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) :
  (Matrix.vandermonde v).det = ∏ i, ∏ j > i, (v j - v i)
Polynomial.coeff_mul.{u} {R : Type u} [Semiring R] (p q : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) :
  (p * q).coeff n = ∑ x ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, p.coeff x.1 * q.coeff x.2
